listing.name: Harvest Moon: Back to Nature — harvest-moon-btn-psx-recomp (JorgeNachtigall)
listing.summary: Upstream reports the town, farm, cutscenes and audio. Full-motion video and complete calendar/save progression remain unconfirmed. A private app embeds your own disc data; keep it private. Portcove has not confirmed runtime behavior or gameplay. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS-01115 Harvest Moon: Back to Nature disc in CUE/BIN form. The documented route generates OpenBIOS locally. Keep your original files separately.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow tools/regen.sh to extract and generate code from your own game and BIOS, then build.sh. Baked overlays and a private app build are optional. Portcove does not install or prepare this source project automatically.
